content.short: INX One is a centralized, US-based cryptocurrency exchange established in 2020.
content.description: INX One is a centralized, US-based platform where users can trade cryptocurrencies, invest in security tokens, and participate in primary offerings with a single, integrated experience. As a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, it has implemented safeguards to protect customer funds in digital asset trading, including legally segregating funds used for digital asset activities. This protective framework aligns with established market practices, emphasizing accurate fund accounting, clear disclosure, and adequate liability coverage to safeguard client assets and support transparent operations in an evolving landscape.
